jobs.occupation: La Lorraine Bakery Group - Data Engineer (Production & Supply Chain)
jobs.description:
As a Data Engineer - Production & Supply Chain, you transform operational data into reliable and scalable data products that support reporting, Power BI, Machine Learning, and AI applications.

Working with data from ERP, MES, WMS, and other operational systems, you design and maintain data pipelines, models, and integrations that make data accessible, trustworthy, and actionable across the organization.

Together with BI/RT Solution Partners, Data Scientists, IT teams, and business stakeholders, you help build solutions that improve decision-making across production, planning, inventory, logistics, service, and quality.
Function

• You develop, maintain, and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines that transform operational data into trusted datasets for BI, analytics, Machine Learning, and AI applications.

• You integrate data from production and supply chain systems such as ERP, MES, WMS, planning, transport, and quality management systems.

• You design and manage data products and semantic models covering topics such as production performance, forecasting, inventory management, Otif, planning, traceability, logistics costs, and operational efficiency.

• You ensure data quality, monitoring, documentation, lineage, and observability, enabling reliable and scalable use of data across the business.

• You apply modern engineering practices such as Version Control, CI/CD, testing, DataOps, and data modelling standards.

• You work closely with Data Scientists, BI professionals, IT teams, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable data solutions and actionable insights.

As a Data Engineer, you will report directly to the Data & Analytics Platform Architect.

• You hold a Master's degree in Data, IT, Engineering, or a related field and have experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or in a similar role. Experience within manufacturing, supply chain, FMCG, or food production is a strong asset.

• You have strong SQL and Python skills and experience working with modern cloud data platforms, preferably Azure, Databricks, or similar lakehouse technologies.

• You have experience with data modelling, ETL/ELT processes, data warehouses, lakehouse architectures, testing, and documentation. Experience with DBT or similar transformation frameworks is considered a plus.

• You understand the importance of data quality, governance, security, observability, and performance, and know how to build scalable and maintainable data solutions.

• You combine strong analytical and communication skills with a pragmatic mindset and enjoy collaborating with both technical teams and business stakeholders.

• You actively leverage AI tools to improve productivity, accelerate development, and enhance collaboration within your team.

• Experience with SAP ERP and related business processes is considered a strong advantage.

• You communicate fluently in English and enjoy collaborating with both technical teams and business stakeholders. Knowledge of Dutch a plus.

jobs.occupation: La Lorraine Bakery Group - Information & Knowledge Architect
jobs.description:
At Llbg, we believe that high-quality information is the foundation of better decisions, efficient collaboration, and successful AI adoption. As our Information & Knowledge Architect, you will define how information is structured, governed, and managed across the organization.

You will create the frameworks, standards, and governance models that transform data and content into trusted business knowledge. Working closely with architects, platform owners, and business stakeholders, you will ensure that information is accessible, reliable, compliant, and ready to power future AI-driven solutions. This is a strategic, hands-on role where architecture, governance, technology, and change management come together.
Function

• You define and own Llbg's information and knowledge architecture, including domain models, business glossaries, taxonomies, metadata standards, and semantic frameworks that create a shared understanding across systems, countries, and teams.

• You establish and drive our information governance framework, ensuring clear ownership, stewardship, quality standards, classification, retention, and lifecycle management for both structured and unstructured information.

• You lead master data governance by defining business object ownership, stewardship responsibilities, standards, and governance processes together with key stakeholders.

• You define how information is created, tagged, classified, versioned, stored, and retired, ensuring that content remains trusted, compliant, and ready to support AI-driven use cases.

• You collaborate closely with architects and platform owners to design and implement information models within governance and Microsoft 365 platforms.

• You establish the governance principles and guardrails for AI access to enterprise knowledge, ensuring compliance with GDPR, the EU AI Act, and internal policies.

• You lead by building. For the first AI Knowledge use cases, you are directly involved in the design and delivery, shaping the content model, retrieval logic, grounding approach, evaluation framework, and adoption journey. By leading these initial implementations, you establish the standards, best practices, and reusable templates that future teams can build upon rather than reinvent

• You engage with business stakeholders across the organization to identify, prioritize, and deliver knowledge management and AI-related initiatives that support Llbg's digital transformation journey.

• You lead and coach the AI Knowledge Engineer while driving adoption, change management, and knowledge stewardship across multiple countries and business domains.

• You hold a Master's degree in Information Science, Data Management, Computer Science, Business Engineering, or a related field.

• You bring 8-12 years of experience combining information governance, data governance, and hands-on technical implementation.

• You have successfully designed and implemented taxonomies, metadata models, semantic structures, or governance frameworks that delivered measurable business value.

• You have experience with master data governance in ERP-driven environments; SAP experience is a strong advantage.

• You have the practical capability to build knowledge AI solutions yourself, from preparing and structuring source content to designing enterprise search and RAG-based experiences.

• You understand the technical and operational work behind successful AI adoption, including metadata, retrieval quality, access controls, testing, user feedback, and long-term ownership

• You are familiar with governance and catalog solutions such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Alation, Unity Catalog, or similar platforms, and communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of Dutch is a strong asset.

Unpaid (with potential for full-time employment post-internship)

We recruit for mindset, ambition, cultural fit, and growth opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Head of Inside Sales & Customer Development
jobs.description:
Our client is an international, fast-growing organization operating in a highly dynamic and data-driven B2B environment. As part of a leading European group, the Belgian organization combines entrepreneurial agility with the structure and support of an international matrix organization. To support its continued growth and further strengthen its customer-facing operations, our client is looking for a Head of Inside Sales & Customer Development.

Jobomschrijving

As Head of Inside Sales & Customer Development, you will play a pivotal leadership role within the Belgian organization. You will be responsible for leading a team of 30-35 Inside Sales & Customer Advisors across multiple locations, ensuring operational excellence, commercial performance and an outstanding customer experience. 

Working closely with both the Belgian leadership team and international stakeholders, you will translate strategic objectives into clear deliverables driving accountability and ownership. 

• Build a high-performing organisation by developing talent, empowering Team Leads and fostering a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement. 
• Establish clear performance frameworks, monitor business-critical KPIs and proactively steer the organisation towards ambitious commercial and operational objectives. 
• Continuously evaluate and optimise workflows, sales processes and customer interactions to improve efficiency, quality and overall business performance. 
• Leverage data, reporting and digital tools to identify trends, generate actionable insights and support informed decision-making. 
• Act as the driving force behind operational change, successfully embedding new initiatives, technologies and best practices across the organisation. 
• Build trusted relationships with key internal stakeholders, ensuring strong cross functional collaboration and alignment within an international matrix environment. 
• Champion a customer-centric mindset by balancing commercial ambition with service excellence and long-term customer value. 
• Play an active role within the Belgian Management Team, contributing to the company's strategic direction and supporting its continued growth. 

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, providing a strong foundation for a commercial leadership role. 
• Proven track record managing larger inside sales, contact centre or customer service teams within a B2B environment preferably within an international and/or matrix driven organisation. 
• Extensive people management experience and know how to coach teams towards performance and accountability. 
• Strong analytical mindset combined with experience managing performance through KPIs, reporting and data analysis. 
• Demonstrated experience improving operational processes and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. 
• Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively across different organizational levels. 
• Comfortable working in a fast-changing environment where adaptability and resilience are essential. 
• Affinity with digital transformation, AI tools and process automation is considered a plus. 
• Fluency in Dutch, French and English are required.
